title: Local TTS in Unity: create and use your own voices
author: formicidfighter

comments.author: formicidfighter
comments.body:
Hey everyone, we’re working on a product to create your own TTS voice models from a few reference audio clips. We’ve been able to create good models with just 10 seconds of reference audio. You can download the finetuned models and use them however you like. We also have a Unity package that helps you easily load them into the engine.

We think devs should have more creative control over the data models are trained on and own the model itself (just like any other game asset). We’re working hard to bring smaller models like Kokoro to the platform for better performance. Try it out at [aviad.ai](http://aviad.ai) and let us know if you’d like any more features or capabilities (join our Discord)!

comments.author: name_was_taken
comments.body: The voice's audio sounds blown out at the start of the clip.  It gave me an immediately extreme negative reaction.

replies.author: formicidfighter
replies.body: For sure, thanks for the feedback. We're working hard to improve model quality and performance. Do you use TTS in your games currently?

replies.body: Not even model quality -- that seems decent, actually -- you just need to normalize the audio levels on the video!
